title: DHCP 拿不到地址
symptom: 接入侧已配置DHCP中继，核心DHCP服务器也在运行，但下挂PC始终无法获取IP地址。
topology:
flowchart LR
PC1[PC] --> SW1[SW1 接入交换机]
SW1 --> R1[R1 中继路由器]
R1 --> R2[R2 核心/DHCP服务器]

shows.output:
DHCP relay statistics:
  Received from clients      : 12
  Received from servers      : 0
  Sent to servers            : 12
  Sent to clients            : 0
  Discarded                  : 0

shows.cmd: display ip interface brief | include GigabitEthernet0/0/1
shows.output:
Interface            IP Address/Mask    Physical  Protocol
GigabitEthernet0/0/1 10.1.2.1/24        up        up

options.label: R1 中继指向的 DHCP 服务器地址配置错误
R1 的接口地址掩码写错了
R2 没有开启 DHCP 服务
R1 与 R2 之间的链路没有 up

explain: R1 向服务器发送了12个请求但收到0个回应，说明中继报文发往的服务器地址不可达；而 R2 实际地址为10.1.2.1，R1 却指向10.1.2.100。用 display dhcp relay statistics 结合 display current-configuration | include dhcp-server 即可确认。
